summary: Greenland. Parliamentary democracy (parliament of greenland or inatsisartut).
rulers: King FREDERIK X of Denmark (since 14 January 2024), represented by High Commissioner Julie Praest WILCHE (since May 2022) (2024); Prime Minister Jens-Frederik NIELSEN (since 28 March 2025)
government: parliamentary democracy (Parliament of Greenland or Inatsisartut)
economy: high-income, self-governing Danish territorial economy; non-EU member but preferential market access; dependent on Danish financial support; exports led by fishing industry; growing tourism and interest in untapped mineral deposits; relies on hydropower for fuel GDP (PPP): $4.04 billion (2023 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
origin: none (extensive self-rule as part of the Kingdom of Denmark)
